data.title: Rivana - The Valley
data.about:
Welcome to Rivana at the Valley, a truly exceptional residential development brought to you by Emaar Properties, nestled in the popular neighbourhood of The Valley in Dubai. Prepare to go on a journey of rare luxury as you tour these stunning residences that defy words. Spanning three magnificent levels, including two upper floors, these residences redefine the very concept of spaciousness, surpassing the dimensions of previously marketed villas. 

Whether you want a serene sanctuary in a 3-bedroom villa or wish to indulge in the glory of a 5-bedroom abode, each residence features a minimum surface area of 300m2, guaranteeing plenty of space for families to flourish and luxuriate in a life of luxury. Prepare to be fascinated by a revolutionary architectural concept that sets Rivana apart. Each property is meticulously paired, resulting in a design symphony, with the pièce de résistance being the distinctive L-shaped garden and enclosed garage. You will see the dawn of a new age here, where contemporary life smoothly blends with unparalleled beauty. 

These paired villas have been deliberately designed to provide a lifestyle that goes beyond the ordinary, with every detail carefully addressed to guarantee your every wish is met inside the bounds of these gorgeous abodes. Prepare to be enchanted by Rivana at the Valley—a lavish indulgence sanctuary where luxury meets serenity and fantasies become a reality. Within these walls, you will find a world where architectural expertise, lavish comforts, and natural splendour combine to create an intriguing and timeless environment. Welcome to Rivana, the starting point for your incredible journey.

location_tile.title: Ideally situated within the scenic landscapes of The Valley
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Welcome to Rivana Twin Villas, ideally situated within the scenic landscapes of The Valley, Dubai. This prime address effortlessly combines tranquillity with accessibility, offering residents a strategic location that connects seamlessly to major transportation routes. With Al Ain Road Dubai at its doorstep, Rivana Twin Villas provides convenient access to various leisure, shopping, dining, and entertainment options. Experience the perfect fusion of serenity and convenience at Rivana Twin Villas, where every aspect of a fulfilling lifestyle is within reach.

  • 05 Minutes – Dubai Rugby Sevens
  • 05 Minutes – Outlet Mall
  • 08 Minutes – Dubai Outlet Mall
  • 10 Minutes – Academic City
  • 25 Minutes – Burj Khalifa / The Dubai Mall
  • 25 Minutes – Dubai International Airport
